{"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-5056aa73","level":1},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"引子"}]},{"type":"horizontalRule"},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-52c45d77"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"看啊，又一位年轻的勇者踏上了旅途，"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-7bdc95ec"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"因为他有着最完美的黄金头发"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-429a2268"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"因为他有着最高洁的宝石眼睛"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-3e99723d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"我们可怜的、可爱的、毫不知命运的勇者"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-16fb2be3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"哦，我也还记得，仿佛就在昨日"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-ce088ba3"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"在战争胜利之前"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-48359aab"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"只是勇者死了"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-92c46bd2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"魔王也应该死了"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-29a45c18"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"那为什么又一位勇者呢？"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-29964358"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"只是这个帝国又需要一位勇者"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-3fb5c756"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"我们可悲的，可敬的，已经死去了的勇者"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-898457e2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"从此往前，所有战争已经以荣誉终结"}]},{"type":"horizontalRule"},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-8cb4466b","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"一分钟读懂世界"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-fee874c6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"欢迎来到《无星之夜与救世英雄传说》，简称《无星夜》。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-414985c1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"这是一个“多元宇宙世界”——每一个独立的“主要阵营”或者说场景都是无数个“泡世界”之一，而我们的故事将会从“希伦特”开始，这也是世界观的主要的局内人叙事角度。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-19"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"不过，你也不一定非要按照叙事顺序来阅读，就像战锤——你可以选择一个你喜爱的阵营作为开始——以及主要阵营内部还有更细致的划分——"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"center","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-19"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"坏消息：缝合怪；好消息：全缝了"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-1cb5eab4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"本主页是世界观的入口与索引，只做概述与导航。想从战争的一侧开始阅读？下面按纪元、种族、地理、力量四块展开，细节请循内链前往各设定。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-13450700","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"纪元时间轴"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-620607c5"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"textStyle","attrs":{"color":null,"fontSize":"20px"}},{"type":"bold"}],"text":"希伦特"},{"type":"text","text":"的学者以「命运历」记录万古。从造物循环到帝国时代，这个世界的命运几经倒转、再三重写。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-0055a2da"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"造物循环·希伦特之前"},{"type":"text","text":"（约五万年前）：希伦特作为四散的元素界在以太潮流中存在，其岁月已不可考，学者仅能借生命树研究推知一二。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-ff7bac32"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"希伦特创世"},{"type":"text","text":"（约前 5 万—前 2.5 万年）：元素界诞生并融合，主位面随之浮现；世界由混乱趋于稳定，多样生命从原始生命树扩散向各地。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-8517adc7"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"神代"},{"type":"text","text":"（约前 2.5 万—前 1.68 万年，约九千年）：第一位种族神诞生，第一座城邦建起。古龙、魔兽与自然伟力的狂野时代，神明多为自私的种族神，各护其眷属。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-0c02fe72"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"黄金时代"},{"type":"text","text":"（约前 1.68 万—前 1.25 万年，约四千年）：人类与类人的黄金时代。以大理石与石灰铸起城邦，万神殿、半神英雄与征伐史诗，智慧取代野性。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-00a59b6e"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"白银时代"},{"type":"text","text":"（约前 1.25 万—前 6400 年，约六千年）：类人中的高等精灵建立魔法帝国，推动魔法第一次革命，原始符文向精灵铭文演进；最终以「天堂坠落」告终——今之精灵族裔与古代高等精灵实非同一。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-325e1f70"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"黑铁时代"},{"type":"text","text":"（约前 6400 年—前 2300 年，约四千年）：高等精灵辉煌散尽，诸国征战不休；魔界碰撞带来天外魔族，迫使各族寻求一切力量。神降的希伦特王国于此崛起。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-b6884eb5"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"希伦特时代"},{"type":"text","text":"（前 2300 年起，命运历 0 年定历，延续至今）：希伦特统一旧大陆、改国为帝国。位面边界不稳，世界崩坏的裂纹蔓延；与多尼雷等异界文明的接触带来冲击与新生。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-c0977851"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"更完整的编年与逐纪详述，见《于世界之门前》「世界通史」一卷。"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"《于世界之门前》——教材版本","fontSize":null}}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-fix-31"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-fix-32"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"textStyle","attrs":{"color":null,"fontSize":"20px"}},{"type":"bold"}],"text":"多尼雷"},{"type":"text","text":"则被划分为了大崩塌前与大崩塌后，大崩塌前的多尼雷是赛博朋克，大崩塌后则是人工智能赡养。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-33"}},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-dd7229ac","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"种族与阵营"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-GAgs8MxF"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"这个世界没有唯一的主角种族——各具特色的种族彼此争战，以及其在这场“大变局”中的反应与变化，才是《无星夜》的主基调。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-lzMbv4f0"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"三种文明，三种基调："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-c407f4e0"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"希伦特·魔法"},{"type":"text","text":"：神降之国。以对新魔法体系的把握与组织能力统合旧大陆，建立帝国，疆域已覆盖希伦特陆地的七成有余。希伦特（故事的开始）"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-8b8d53fa"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"多尼雷·科技"},{"type":"text","text":"：元素消沉的世界，疑似上一个循环的主世界。类人种以基因技术与遍布各处的智能机械供养文明，宛如希伦特的镜像与未来。"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"多尼雷","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"（各异技术路线就是各异朋克）"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-4a36bb93"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"法奈耶·蛮荒"},{"type":"text","text":"：元素比希伦特更为活跃，文明仍处于部落与原始城邦时代，生灵强大、物种繁茂，令人联想到神代。"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"法奈耶","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"（喜欢大恐龙吗？）"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-ffea4a71"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"在文明内部，阵营源于最初决定力量性质的「超凡道途」，可归纳为善良·邪恶·中立 × 绝对·混乱·守序的九宫格——它是性格的总结，也是价值观的归纳。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-0235f967","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"地理速览"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-42"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"textStyle","attrs":{"color":null,"fontSize":"20px"}},{"type":"bold"}],"text":"希伦特"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-f8cf6216"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"以文化圈简分地域（希伦特）——大地、海洋与地下。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fad1ff78"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"地上·希伦特大陆"},{"type":"text","text":"：大陆人文化圈，帝国腹地，伟大之城"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"希伦特城","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-27668767"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"沙陆与群岛"},{"type":"text","text":"：萨赫拉诸邦（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"羽亚人","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·瑟拉菲）、南方诸国与南方群岛（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"鳞亚人","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·大聚馆）、厄尔辛与凯尔领（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"兽亚人","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·灰痕堡）。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-ea19d628"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"异界与新大陆"},{"type":"text","text":"：魔界（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"魔族","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·魔王城）、新大陆（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"树人","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·始源圣殿）。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-6573159d"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"海洋"},{"type":"text","text":"：南海陆洋（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"鱼人","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·华沙）、黄金环海（"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"人鱼","fontSize":null}},{"type":"text","text":"·亚特兰）、北希伦特洋隙（鲎人·沉渊城）。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-a33a258c"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"地下·石质圈层"},{"type":"text","text":"：幽暗地域（夜裔亚人·伦登城）、阿拉克涅回廊（蛛类·千窟城）。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-b9de90a4"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"地下·水晶与深渊"},{"type":"text","text":"：地下菌丛（蕈人·热忱花园）、地脉回廊（晶魄·绚辉城）、悬浊海（有神灵质·浮沫）、泪渊（浮幽·泪都）。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-edc062b9","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"力量体系"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-51"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"——通用的力量评级——在游戏中，无论是多尼雷还是希伦特都遵守这一规则，而故事中，这一体系则是由希伦特构建的。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-04bad861"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"万物的资质可由九项属性衡量，分作三组——超凡者尤甚。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-7895179c"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"素质三项：力量、体质、反应"},{"type":"text","text":"——战士系的核心，可通过锻炼与实战成长，是相对易得的基础属性。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-dc4d04ad"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"精神三项：智慧、意志、感知"},{"type":"text","text":"——法师、牧师与游侠的资质，稳定而昂贵，只能以学习、外物或重大变故去撼动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-7f454ae7"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"神秘三项：位格、亲和、魅力"},{"type":"text","text":"——神秘学与炼金的核心；位格关乎「命运线」与等价交换，亲和为德鲁伊所偏爱，魅力则是通用的情商。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-faa534b9"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"阵营"},{"type":"text","text":"——源于超凡道途，九宫格：善良·邪恶·中立 × 绝对·混乱·守序。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-af124c66"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"九项属性的细则与职业分野，见《于世界之门前》「超越凡俗」一卷。"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"《于世界之门前》——教材版本","fontSize":null}}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-19ec633b","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"造物循环与元素"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-2980e3cc"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"希伦特的学者认为，世界诞生于以太——那无性质的原初元素。以太潮流分化出火、气、水、土、生命、死亡六种基础元素；元素聚合、沉积、分层，最终汇聚成世界。主世界与元素界如同潮流中的泡沫，随浪而起，随波而散——从以太中来，回以太中去，此即造物循环。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-8094df1f"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"世界并非唯一。无数泡沫世界在同一片原初之洋中浮沉，旅法师穿行其间，带回壁垒之外的信息。最近也最无可辩驳的证明，便是魔界与希伦特世界的碰撞——黑铁时代的世界乱战因此裂为世界两极而延续。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-5871ab50"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"基础元素"},{"type":"text","text":"：火（红·物质／黄·解离／白·聚合／蓝·灵性）、气（蓝·滋养／白·变动／绿·积聚／紫·异化）、水（白·无根／蓝·延续／灰·腐败／黑·静滞）、土（黄·无相／灰·沉积／银·力量／白·永恒）、生命（翠绿·萌动／暖金·繁盛／赤红·炽烈／纯白·超越）、死亡（冷灰·冷却／暗白·归还／深紫·遗忘／纯黑·虚无）。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-1771288f"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"次级元素"},{"type":"text","text":"：风、雷、光、暗——由基础元素混合模拟而出的复杂自然力量。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-296f914a"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"元素性质与色相的完整解说，见《元素导论》与《于世界之门前》相关篇章。"},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"《于世界之门前》——教材版本","fontSize":null}}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-65"}},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-65"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"——当然，当然，这同样是希伦特眼中的世界。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left","indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-fix-66"}},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-aac063e4","level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"阅读路线图"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":"2em","id":"b-409e8e63"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"本主页只是入口。想深入这个世界——"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-04dedf72"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"从种族开始"},{"type":"text","text":"：选择一种你感兴趣的文明——希伦特（魔法）、多尼雷（科技）、法奈耶（蛮荒），或大陆人、羽亚人、鳞亚人、兽亚人、魔族等各族的设定。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-0bab38fa"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"从游戏开始"},{"type":"text","text":"：本世界脱胎于游戏策划案，可按「游戏主线」的视角走入世界。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":null,"indent":0,"textIndent":null,"id":"b-6fa21546"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"《无星之夜与救世英雄传说》正在制作中~ 对策划案有建议、或对团队与相关技术感兴趣，欢迎直接在策划案下留言："},{"type":"inlink","attrs":{"href":null,"itemId":null,"itemType":"definition","label":"《无星之夜与救世英雄传说——游戏策划案》","fontSize":null}}]}]}
